name: Kongou Battleship
description: Kongo is the No. 1 Japanese Kongo-class battlecruiser and was active in the Pacific Theater during World War II. After two modifications, it became the Japanese battleship with a speed of 30 knots at that time. It has a length of 222 meters, a width of 31.7 meters, and is equipped with 8 twin 356 mm main guns; 14 152 mm secondary guns and other equipment. In the Battle of Leyte Gulf, it sank the USS Gambier Bay aircraft carrier and a destroyer, which was a brilliant achievement in its service career.
